regions.today: Today will be a rather cloudy day. Mainly dry with the best of the sunny spells in the east and southeast. Mild and humid with highest temperatures of 17 to 19 degrees in a moderate south to southwest breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be rather cloudy and misty but dry, apart from patchy outbreaks of drizzle. Misty in places too. Relatively mild with lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees in a moderate southwesterly breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, apart from some early mist and drizzle, it will be dry with a lot of cloud and some bright or sunny spells. Mild and humid with highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees in a light to moderate west to southwest breeze.
